'''''Star Wars: Hyperspace Stories—Tides of Terror''''' is a [[2025]] [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries published as part of the ''[[Star Wars: Hyperspace Stories]]'' series. The four-issue series was written by [[George Mann]], illustrated by [[Luis Morocco]], [[Le Beau Underwood]], and [[Michael Atiyeh]], with the [[Hyperspace Stories—Tides of Terror 1|first issue]] published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[July 30]], 2025.
